name: Matt Runs Down the Street
description: Matt bursts out of his house and sprints down the street.
related_events: Matt runs down the street after leaving his house

name: Matt Discovers the Corpse
description: Matt opens the door and pulls back the curtain. Behind it lies a corpse.
related_events: Matt opens the door and pulls back the curtain to reveal a corpse

name: Matt King Calls Barb Higgins About Their Daughters
description: Matt King returns a phone call to Barb Higgins. He introduces himself and mentions that he is returning her call. Barb confirms her identity, and Matt notes that their daughters are classmates. Barb responds that her daughter Lani is indeed in the same class as Matt's daughter Scottie.
related_events: Matt King returns Barb Higgins's call about their daughters being classmates

name: Matt Enters the Building
description: Matt walks up to the building and opens the front door. He steps inside and closes the door behind him.
related_events: Matt enters the building through the front door

name: Matt Hears Laughter at the Door
description: Matt walks toward the door. As he gets closer, he hears laughter coming from inside.
related_events: Matt approaches the door and hears laughter from inside

name: Matt and Scottie See The Big Island
description: Matt and Scottie stand by the window, watching as The Big Island appears on the horizon. The land grows clearer as they approach, its shape defined against the sea and sky.
related_events: Matt and Scottie observe The Big Island from a distance

name: Red Rental Car Speeds Along Kona Road
description: A red rental car speeds along a road near Kona, moving swiftly across a rocky, lunar-like landscape.
related_events: Red rental car speeds along road near Kona

name: Matt Sprints Around a Corner
description: Matt comes sprinting around a corner, moving quickly and without hesitation.
related_events: Matt sprints around a corner

name: Scottie Comes Out of the Water Hungry
description: Scottie emerges from the surf, pulling off her snorkel mask and shaking the water from her hair. She walks up the beach toward Matt, who is sitting on a towel, and says, "I'm hungry!" Matt looks at her, then stands, brushing sand off his hands. "What else is new?" he says. "Let's get you something to eat."
related_events: Scottie emerges from the water and expresses hunger
Matt decides to get food for Scottie

name: Neurologist Observes Matt's Responses During Examination
description: The neurologist watched Matt closely as stimuli were applied. Matt reacted without clear purpose, his responses mostly random and inconsistent. At times, he showed signs of specific awareness, but these moments were fleeting. His reflexes remained primitive and unchanged, regardless of what was presented.
related_events: Neurologist assesses Matt's diagnosis with non-purposeful reactions to stimuli

name: Matt and Scottie Arrive Home
description: Matt drives the car down the street and pulls up in front of the house. He turns off the engine, opens his door, and steps out. Scottie opens the passenger side door and gets out as well. They both walk toward the front door. As they approach, Matt's voice can be heard, saying, 'Alexandra with her drugs and older guys and modeling.'
related_events: Matt and Scottie return home in car

name: Matt Enters the Neighbors' House Through the Kitchen
description: Matt arrives at his neighbors' house and walks directly to the kitchen door. He opens it and lets himself in without knocking or calling out.
related_events: Matt arrives at his neighbors' house
Matt lets himself in through the kitchen door

name: Matt Eats Lunch and Receives a Surprise Visit from His Cousins
description: Matt eats a sack lunch at his desk, looking out over the downtown skyline. His diplomas from Punahou, college, and law school hang on the wall nearby. His secretary, Noe, opens the door and tells him his cousins have arrived.
related_events: Matt eats sack lunch at his desk
Noe informs Matt about his cousins' arrival

name: Carry Alex Upstairs with Scottie's Help
description: Matt carries the unconscious Alex up the stairs. Scottie runs ahead, reaches the top, and opens the door to the room.
related_events: Matt carries unconscious Alex upstairs
Scottie runs ahead and opens door

name: Climb Stairs and Voice Hopes for Reconciliation
description: Matt bypasses the elevator and walks up the stairs. As he climbs, his voice carries a quiet conviction. He speaks of Elizabeth waking up, returning to Scottie and Alexandra, and the two of them talking about their marriage. He talks about selling the land, leaving his practice, buying her a big boat, a house in France, a trip around the world—just the two of them. He remembers how close they once were and says it’s still in them.
related_events: Matt climbs stairs instead of using elevator
Matt reflects on Elizabeth's recovery and their future

name: Matt Arrives at the Ocean Outrigger Club
description: Joggers pass by as Matt's car pulls into the driveway of the Ocean Outrigger Club. The building is active, with signs of a gathering underway.
related_events: Matt's car arrives at the Ocean Outrigger Club driveway

name: Barb Higgins Greets the Visitor
description: Barb Higgins opened the door. She looked at the visitor and said, 'Thank you for coming by.'
related_events: Barb Higgins answers the door
Barb Higgins thanks visitor for coming

name: Matt Receives an Urgent Call About His Daughter
description: Matt stands by his wife’s bedside, watching her lie unconscious after twenty-three days in a coma. He thinks about the doctors’ impending decision and remembers that she has a living will, which means the choice about her care may no longer be his to make. He insists to himself that she will pull through. His cellphone rings. He answers and hears Noe’s voice, telling him that Scottie’s teacher is on the line and says it’s urgent. Matt takes the call.
related_events: Matt reflects on wife's coma and living will
Matt receives urgent phone call about Scottie

name: Matt Comforts Scottie and Suggests a Trip to Bring His Sister Home
description: Matt catches up to Scottie and tells him not to pay attention to a man they both dislike. Scottie says he hates the man and then admits he didn’t mean to say 'dead chicken,' clarifying that he doesn’t want his mom to die. Matt reassures him, then suggests they leave right away to do something spontaneous—drive to the airport and fly to the Big Island to surprise Scottie’s sister. He says they can bring her home, adding that he thinks she should be with them. Scottie asks if they would go right now, and Matt confirms. Scottie agrees, saying he’s out of school and that his sister should be home too.
related_events: Matt confronts Scottie about his outburst
Scottie expresses fear about his mother's death
Matt proposes an impromptu trip to the Big Island
Scottie agrees to the trip to bring his sister home

name: Locked Out at the Birthday Party
description: Scottie and Matt drive past a row of modest homes, stopping near a house on the corner. Scottie says the house belongs to someone who invites him to her birthday every year. He remembers last year's party, when she locked him out and he had to sit outside all day while everyone else stayed inside. After that, he became friends with Reina and Brooke, and things changed—he became more popular.
related_events: Scottie recalls being locked out of birthday party
Scottie becomes friends with Reina and Brooke

name: Matt Helps Alex Rest
description: Matt lifts Alex onto her bed, carefully slides off her shoes, and pulls a blanket over her. He stands nearby, watching as she lies still, her breathing slow and steady under the cover.
related_events: Matt places Alex on her bed
Matt removes Alex's shoes
Matt covers Alex with a blanket
Matt observes Alex resting

name: Matt Retrieves Alexandra from Dorm Late at Night
description: Matt King arrives at the dorm supervisor's residence late at night and knocks on the door. The dorm supervisor answers, wearing a nightgown, as the television plays in the background. Matt introduces himself and says he needs to pick up his daughter, Alexandra, immediately, explaining that it is an emergency. When asked if he contacted Administration, Matt says he did not. After a brief pause, the dorm supervisor agrees to help him despite the lack of prior notice.
related_events: Matt knocks on dorm supervisor's door late at night
Dorm supervisor appears in nightgown to answer door
Matt requests to pick up daughter Alexandra from dorm
Dorm supervisor agrees to assist despite lack of prior notice

name: Matt Studies Family Papers and Reflects on Ancestry
description: The camera moves past photos of Matt's ancestors, shelves of books on Hawaiian history, and scattered family memorabilia, settling on Matt at his desk, surrounded by papers. A clock on the wall reads 1:20. He looks down at the documents, then speaks quietly. His voice tells of his great-great-grandmother, Princess Margaret Ke'alohilani, a direct descendant of King Kamehameha, who was meant to marry her hanai brother but instead fell in love with Edward King, a haole banker and estate manager whose parents were missionaries. He recounts how land deals and her inheritance brought generations of wealth through leases and sales. Now, the trust that has held their land is being dissolved by law, and the last parcel of undeveloped land is set to be sold. Matt lifts his eyes to the portraits of Edward and Margaret hanging nearby. He says he wants to be a normal citizen, like everyone else, and that he just wants to be a normal guy.
related_events: Matt studies family documents at his desk
Matt narrates his family lineage and inheritance history
Matt reflects on the dissolution of the family trust
Matt gazes at the portraits of his ancestors Edward and Margaret
Matt expresses desire to live as a normal citizen

name: Matt and Scottie Depart for Kona
description: Matt and Scottie walk toward the exit as a Hawaiian Airlines inter-island plane lifts off from the airport. A dotted line on a map traces the flight route from Honolulu to Kona.
related_events: Hawaiian Airlines inter-island airplane takes off from airport
Flight path is shown on map from Honolulu to Kona

name: Scottie Flips Off Troy at the Airport
description: As Matt and Scottie walk toward the airport exit, Scottie turns and flips off Troy. Troy stands there, his expression visibly crestfallen.
related_events: Scottie flips off crestfallen Troy as they head toward the exit

name: Dr. Johnston Tells Matt About Elizabeth's Condition
description: Dr. Johnston sits across from Matt and tells him that Elizabeth’s condition has worsened. He explains that she has multi-factorial anoxic encephalopathy and shows no eye movement, no pupillary response, and no brainstem reflexes. He says her brain damage is irreversible and that she will never regain her previous cognitive or physical abilities. The machines can keep her alive, but her quality of life would be extremely poor. Matt sits still, saying nothing. Dr. Johnston says they must plan for when she will be taken off life support, not if. He mentions organ donation and suggests Matt begin letting people know so they can come say goodbye.
related_events: Doctor delivers prognosis of deteriorating anoxic encephalopathy
Matt receives news about irreversible brain damage

name: Dr. Johnston Tells Matt About Stopping Life Support
description: Dr. Johnston sits across from Matt and tells him that Elizabeth’s condition has worsened, with no brainstem reflexes and no chance of recovery. He explains that she will be taken off life support, and that it is only a matter of when. Matt asks how long she might last, and Dr. Johnston says it could be days or up to two weeks, but advises planning for the shortest timeline. Dr. Johnston mentions the need to start organ donation procedures and reminds Matt that Elizabeth has many friends who should be informed. He suggests beginning to let people know so they can come to say goodbye before she passes.
related_events: Dr. Johnston informs Matt about the inevitability of removing Elizabeth from life support
Matt learns about the necessity of initiating organ donation procedures
Dr. Johnston advises Matt to notify Elizabeth's friends for final goodbyes

name: Matt Observes Elizabeth in Coma After Boating Accident
description: Matt King sits among documents in a hospital room, surrounded by the machinery of intensive care. Elizabeth, his wife, lies on a hospital bed, motionless, with a feeding tube in her nose, a ventilator in her throat, and IV lines in her arm. Machines hum and monitor her condition as Matt looks at her, recalling the day she was thrown from a powerboat during a race, hitting her head and nearly drowning. It has been 23 days since the accident. He sees the stiffness in her body, the tilt of her head, the tubes that keep her alive. Doctors have assessed her condition, noting minimal response, with scores indicating an extremely deep coma. Matt watches her, surrounded by old magazines and medical equipment, as the reality of her condition settles over him.
related_events: Elizabeth King suffers head injury and near-drowning in powerboat accident
Matt King observes comatose woman on hospital bed with medical support systems
Elizabeth King is assessed with severe coma using Glasgow and Rancho Los Amigos scales
Matt King reflects on 23 days of hospital life as personal hell

name: Matt Works at Hospital Bedside
description: Matt King sits beside a hospital bed, surrounded by stacks of documents spread across a makeshift desk. He reviews papers, writes notes, and flips through files, pausing occasionally to glance at his wife, Elizabeth, who lies motionless in the bed, connected to tubes and machines. The quiet hum of the ventilator fills the room as he returns to his work, turning pages and signing documents without speaking.
related_events: Matt King works amid documents on makeshift desk in hospital room

name: Matt Removes Inappropriate Postcards from Hospital Gift Shop
description: Matt stands at a postcard rack in a hospital gift shop, staring at a card showing a young girl in a bikini straddling a surfboard, laughing as water splashes around her. He grabs all the postcards from the rack and brings them to the counter, along with two sodas. The shopkeeper looks at him strangely and asks if he wants to buy all the cards or if she should put them back. Matt says he is buying them. As she rings up the items, she remarks, 'You like buy underage girl all for yourself.' Matt pays without responding. Outside the store, in the lobby, he drops the stack of postcards into a garbage bin.
related_events: Matt grabs all postcards from the rack
Matt purchases postcards and two sodas from shopkeeper
Matt confronts shopkeeper about inappropriate postcards
Matt disposes of postcards in garbage bin outside store

name: Matt Notices Protest Headline While Buying Postcards
description: At the counter, as the shopkeeper rings up the postcards and two sodas, Matt sees a newspaper headline stacked nearby: "Activists Continue Protest of Kaua'i Sale." He pauses, looking at the headline before handing over his wallet to pay.
related_events: Matt notices protest headline on newspaper

name: Matt Confronts Scottie About the Hospital Photos
description: Matt leads Scottie to the car and asks what’s wrong with her for showing pictures of her mother in the hospital for her art project. Scottie says she’s a real photographer and explains that she saw a famous photographer do the same thing—taking pictures of her mother while she was sick—and that the images became art. Matt tells her their mother is not dying, just very sick, and that personal family matters shouldn’t be shared with strangers. Scottie changes the subject, saying she’s hungry and asking if they can get burgers. Matt says no. She asks about smoothies. He says no again. As she keeps talking, Matt thinks to himself that the last time he took care of Scottie alone was when she was one year old. Now she’s ten, and he doesn’t understand what’s going on in her mind. He thinks she’s acting out, especially with Elizabeth in the hospital, and that Scottie might be testing him. He feels like the backup parent, the understudy.
related_events: Matt leads Scottie to the car
Matt confronts Scottie about sharing private family matters
Scottie defends his photography project featuring his mother

name: Scottie Asks for Burgers and Smoothies
description: After the argument about the photographs, Scottie asks if they can get burgers. Matt says no. She then asks if they can get smoothies. Matt says no again. As Scottie keeps talking, Matt thinks back to the last time he took care of her by himself, when she was one year old. Now she is ten, and he feels unsure about what she is thinking. With Elizabeth in the hospital, he feels out of his depth, as if he is the understudy parent.
related_events: Scottie asks Matt for burgers and smoothies

name: Matt and Scottie Leave Barb Higgins's House
description: Matt and Scottie pause at the door to put their shoes back on. Barb Higgins says goodbye, wishing Matt luck with the sale and mentioning the impact his decision could have on Kaua'i. Matt acknowledges her words, then he and Scottie step outside. Barb closes the door behind them as they walk away.
related_events: Matt and Scottie put on their shoes before leaving
Matt and Scottie depart from Barb Higgins's home

name: Barb Higgins Shares Concerns About the Land Sale
description: The door opens, and Matt and Scottie pause to put their shoes back on. Barb Higgins calls out to Matt, wishing him good luck with the sale. Matt turns to look at her. She mentions that his decision will have a major impact on Hawai'i's real estate and the landscape of Kaua'i, noting the hundreds of millions of dollars involved. She adds that her husband's family is from Hanapepe on Kaua'i, and they hope he does not sell. Matt responds quietly, 'Big decision.' As Matt and Scottie walk away, Barb closes the door behind them.
related_events: Barb Higgins comments on the real estate sale decision
Barb Higgins reveals her family's connection to Kaua'i
Matt reacts to Barb Higgins's remarks about the sale

name: Matt and Scottie Talk About Lani
description: As Matt and Scottie walk away from the house, Matt asks if Scottie will try to act differently around Lani. Scottie says he’ll try, but it’s hard because she has a face you just want to hit. Matt agrees.
related_events: Matt asks Scottie about changing behavior toward Lani
Scottie expresses difficulty in treating Lani differently

name: Matt and Nurse Joy in the Hallway
description: Matt steps into the hallway and passes Nurse Joy. She greets him, asking how he is. He replies that he’s fine and returns the question. Nurse Joy mentions seeing his picture in the paper and asks if he’s made his decision yet about his family’s land. Matt responds with surprise, questioning what decision she means. Before she can elaborate, another nurse nudges her, prompting a more polite approach. Nurse Joy insists she and Matt are on familiar terms. Matt explains that the decision isn’t his alone—it belongs to the whole family—and adds with mock scolding that she should mind her own business. He turns and continues down the hall.
related_events: Matt exchanges greetings with Nurse Joy in the hallway
Nurse Joy inquires about Matt's decision regarding his family's land
Another nurse nudges Nurse Joy to be more polite
Matt deflects Nurse Joy's question with mock scolding
related_occasions: Family Meeting To Approve A Buyer For The Kaua'I Land

name: Matt Confronts the Weight of the Land Decision
description: As Matt walks down the hallway, he exchanges brief pleasantries with Nurse Joy, who mentions seeing his picture in the paper and asks if he’s made a decision about his family’s land. Matt deflects, saying it’s not just his decision and telling her to mind her own business. As he continues down the hall, he thinks to himself about the immense pressure he feels as the sole trustee of his family’s 1,000 acres on Kaua’i, land they have owned since the 1860s. He reflects on the upcoming family meeting in six days, where the cousins will gather to approve a buyer. He feels the weight of the entire state watching, and the burden of responsibility from his family, his daughters, and his comatose wife. The strain is heavy, and all he wants is to disappear.
related_events: Matt reflects on the pressure of deciding the fate of his family's land
related_occasions: Family Meeting To Approve A Buyer For The Kaua'I Land

name: Matt Confronts Scottie About Her Texting
description: Matt enters the room to find Scottie sitting on the sofa, giggling and looking at her phone. He asks her what she is doing, and she says she is hungry and wants to leave. Matt asks if she spoke to someone, and when she admits she did, he presses her for details. Scottie refuses, saying the conversation was private. Matt accuses her of lying and demands to see her phone. She resists, but he grabs it from her. After a moment, he relents and agrees to go. Scottie jumps up and calls out, 'Bye, Mom!' before running out the door. Matt pauses, glancing back at Liz with a look of panic and sadness on his face.
related_events: Scottie giggles and texts on her phone while sitting on a sofa
Scottie refuses to disclose the content of her private conversation
Matt accuses Scottie of lying and demands her phone
Scottie resists as Matt snatches her phone away

name: Scottie Leaves After Matt Takes Her Phone
description: Matt grabs Scottie's phone after a struggle. He tells her they can go, and Scottie immediately gets up from the sofa. She calls out, 'Bye, Mom!' toward Liz, who does not respond. Then Scottie runs out the door. Matt looks at Liz one last time before following her.
related_events: Scottie jumps up from the sofa and rushes out the door
Scottie says goodbye to her mother before leaving

name: Matt Pleads with Liz to Wake Up
description: Matt pauses and looks at Liz one last time before leaving. He speaks softly, his voice filled with emotion, asking her to wake up. 'I need you,' he says. 'I can't do this alone.'
related_events: Matt expresses desperation to Liz while looking at her

name: Matt Joins Cousins to Review Development Proposals
description: Matt enters a room where his seven cousins are already gathered, dressed casually with shaggy hair, waiting to begin their meeting. They stand around a conference table, studying blueprints and architectural drawings spread before them. The discussion turns to the bids for a development project in Hawai'i—proposals that include hotels, shopping centers, condos, and golf courses, promising 3000 new jobs in the first five years. A Chicago group has offered half a billion dollars, but attention shifts to a lower bid from Don Holitzer, a man from Kaua'i who made his fortune in Silicon Valley. Cousin Hugh supports Holitzer’s bid, and Matt voices agreement. Amid the conversation, Cousin Dave and Cousin Stan make their opposition to the sale known. As the others talk, Matt stands quietly, his attention drifting as the sound of a ventilator grows in his mind.
related_events: Matt enters the room to find seven cousins waiting
Cousin Dave and Cousin Stan express opposition to the sale

name: Matt and His Cousins Weigh Development Offers
description: Matt stands around the conference table with his cousins, studying blueprints and architectural drawings spread across the surface. The proposals all look similar—hotels, shopping centers, condos, golf courses—each promising 3000 new jobs in the first five years, backed by letters from construction companies and unions. A Chicago group has offered half a billion dollars, but Cousin Hugh speaks up in favor of Don Holitzer, a man from Kaua'i who made his fortune in Silicon Valley and submitted a lower bid. The cousins listen as Hugh makes his case, and Matt considers the options, his gaze shifting between the plans and the faces of his family.
related_events: Matt and cousins review development proposals at conference table
Matt considers Don Holitzer's bid for development project

name: Matt's Attention Drifts to Elizabeth's Condition During Meeting
description: Matt stands around the conference table with his cousins, surrounded by blueprints and architectural drawings. As the others discuss the bids, his focus slips. The sound of Elizabeth's ventilator fills his mind, growing louder. The scene shifts to a series of artistic renderings showing Elizabeth lying in a coma, her image growing larger, more detailed, as if seen through Matt's inner gaze.
related_events: Matt becomes mentally distracted by sound of Elizabeth's ventilator
Narrative shifts to artistic renderings of comatose Elizabeth

name: Matt Confronts Scottie's Harassment of Lani
description: Matt receives a phone call from Barb Higgins, who tells him that her daughter Lani has been receiving offensive messages from Scottie. Barb reads aloud the latest message, which reads, "We all know you grew pubes over the summer," and mentions that Scottie posted it on Lani's Facebook wall. She also says Scottie mocks Lani by calling her Lanikai, implying she is as large as a neighborhood. Barb insists that Scottie come to her house to apologize in person and demands that the messages stop immediately. When Matt notes that Scottie has been struggling due to her mother's illness, Barb dismisses the explanation, saying her daughter comes home in tears and that none of it is acceptable. She warns that if Scottie does not apologize, she will report the behavior to the headmaster. As the conversation continues, Matt sees Scottie outside, sitting on the ground with her back turned, pounding something with a large rock.
related_events: Matt receives a phone call from Barb Higgins about Scottie's behavior
Barb Higgins reports Scottie's offensive messages to Lani
Barb Higgins demands Scottie apologize to Lani
Barb Higgins threatens to report Scottie to the headmaster

name: Matt Observes Scottie Pounding the Ground with a Rock
description: As Matt speaks on the phone with Barb Higgins, who complains about Scottie sending cruel messages to her daughter, he sees Scottie outside in the yard. She sits on the ground with her back turned, repeatedly pounding something with a large rock. He pauses, then mentions to Barb that Scottie’s mother is unwell, suggesting the girl might be acting out because of the stress at home.
related_events: Scottie pounds an object with a large rock in the yard
Matt suggests Scottie's behavior may be linked to her mother's illness

name: Matt Confronts Perceptions of Privilege
description: As Matt speaks on the phone with Barb Higgins, he listens to her complaints about his daughter Scottie sending hurtful messages to her daughter Lani. He acknowledges the behavior is out of character and suggests Scottie’s actions might be tied to her mother’s illness. Barb dismisses the explanation, demanding an apology and threatening to involve the school. From a distance, Lani’s voice is heard saying Scottie can apologize in a good way. After the call, Matt lets out an exasperated breath and, in a quiet moment, reflects on how people see him only as a rich inheritor, burdened by the weight of his last name and the resentment it draws—resentment he sometimes shares.
related_events: Matt expresses frustration about being perceived as the rich inheritor

name: Matt Meets with School Staff About Scottie's Photos
description: Matt sits down with Scottie's fifth-grade teacher, Ms. Hayashi, and school counselor Mrs. Thull to discuss concerns about Scottie sharing photos of her sister Elizabeth lying in a hospital bed with her classmates. The photos, taken at close and unusual angles, upset several students, and some parents have called the school in anger. Matt admits Scottie has been taking a lot of pictures lately but says he didn't know she was sharing these particular ones. Ms. Hayashi explains that Scottie hasn't seemed like herself and that Principal Cruz believes it might be better for her to stay home during this difficult time. Matt hesitates, saying he thought keeping to her normal routine would help, and mentions he’s not sure how to handle things on his own, especially with Elizabeth away at school on the Big Island. Mrs. Thull suggests that Scottie may be struggling to cope and asks if Matt has encouraged her to talk about her feelings. He says he has. Just then, Scottie appears outside the classroom door, dancing and singing with earbuds in, oblivious to the conversation. The staff look at Matt, waiting for him to respond. After a pause, he tells her to knock it off.
related_events: Scottie shares hospital photos with classmates
Matt discusses Scottie's photo sharing with school staff
School staff express concern over Scottie's emotional state

name: Scottie Dances in the Hallway During School Meeting
description: During a meeting with Matt, Ms. Hayashi, and Mrs. Thull, Scottie appears outside the classroom door, dancing and singing loudly with earbuds in her ears. A janitor down the hall watches her with a suspicious look. Ms. Hayashi calls out to Scottie, asking if she is making a good choice, but Scottie remains unaware. Matt, after a moment, tells her to stop, his voice carrying a tone of embarrassment.
related_events: Scottie dances and sings outside classroom with earbuds in
Janitor observes Scottie's behavior with suspicion
Ms. Hayashi confronts Scottie about her behavior
Matt reacts with embarrassment and tells Scottie to stop

name: Mrs. Thull Questions Matt About Scottie's Feelings
description: Mrs. Thull asks Matt if he has been talking with Scottie about what’s happening at home, suggesting it’s important for Scottie to express her emotions during the family’s difficult time. She and Ms. Hayashi have noticed changes in Scottie’s behavior at school, and Mrs. Thull emphasizes that children often act out when something is wrong at home. Matt responds that he has been encouraging Scottie to talk, saying yes several times, though his answer seems uncertain. As he speaks, Scottie can be heard singing down the hallway, dancing outside the classroom with earbuds in, unaware of the conversation about her.
related_events: Mrs. Thull questions Matt about discussing family crisis with Scottie

name: Matt Confronts Scottie About the Messages
description: Matt drives Scottie to their destination. During the ride, he tells Scottie he needs to apologize sincerely and stop messing around. He says he has a lot of work to do and is falling behind, and points out that Scottie made someone cry. He asks why Scottie would be so mean to someone. Scottie, sounding irritated, says he doesn’t know. Matt presses him, asking if he’s always sending nasty texts. Scottie says no, then explains that he writes the messages with Reina—they make her laugh, and she shows them to Megan and Brooke, who also laugh. Matt responds that he should’ve known Reina was involved, and says he doesn’t want Scottie spending time with her. Scottie mentions he already invited Reina to visit him at the hospital since he’s not in school anymore, and asks if she can come. Matt says they’ll make a deal: Scottie has to apologize to the girl and talk to his mother, and then they’ll see about Reina visiting. Just then, Scottie notices something outside the window and exclaims, "Dorks!" Matt tells him to knock it off. Scottie leans back in his seat, laughing. Matt looks in the rearview mirror and sees a teenage boy taking off his T-shirt and throwing it to the ground as six family members walk by carrying kayaks, wearing shirts that read "Melnick Family Reunion."
related_events: Matt demands Scottie apologize sincerely
Matt questions Scottie about sending inappropriate messages
Scottie expresses irritation and uncertainty about his behavior
Scottie explains messages were written with Reina to make others laugh
Matt blames Reina for influencing Scottie negatively

name: Scottie Asks About Reina's Visit
description: Matt drives Scottie to their destination. During the ride, Scottie asks if Reina can visit him in the hospital, since he is no longer in school. Matt responds with conditions: Scottie must apologize to the girl he upset and talk to his mother. Only then will they consider allowing Reina to come. As they speak, Scottie notices a group of people walking by with kayaks, wearing matching shirts that read "Melnick Family Reunion." He laughs and calls them dorks. Matt tells him to stop. In the rearview mirror, Matt sees one of the teenagers in the group take off his shirt and throw it to the ground.
related_events: Scottie requests permission for Reina to visit him in hospital
Matt sets conditions for Reina's hospital visit

name: Scottie Mocks the Melnick Family
description: Scottie notices a group of people walking on the sidewalk carrying kayaks and wearing matching T-shirts that read 'Melnick Family Reunion.' She laughs and calls them 'dorks.' Matt tells her to stop, reprimanding her for being disrespectful. Scottie leans back in her seat, still laughing. Matt glances in the rearview mirror and sees a teenage boy from the group take off his T-shirt and throw it to the ground.
related_events: Scottie notices family members with kayaks outside the window
Matt reprimands Scottie for mocking family members
Teenage son removes and discards his T-shirt

name: Matt Urges Scottie to Speak to Elizabeth
description: Scottie takes a photograph of Elizabeth while she lies in bed. Matt tells her to stop and says she should talk to her mother instead. He reminds her that people in a coma can sometimes hear, and that speaking might help Elizabeth or at least help Scottie. Scottie says she doesn’t know what to say. Matt suggests she tell a story, maybe about school or activities she used to do. Scottie says she doesn’t do gymnastics, soccer, ballet, piano, or hula anymore. Matt says they should leave if she won’t speak. Scottie agrees, ready to go. Matt then suggests she write a letter. Scottie asks what she would write, and questions how Elizabeth would read it. Matt gets frustrated and tells her that right now, Elizabeth is hearing her refusal to talk. Scottie says she’s hungry and wants a Sprite. Matt asks if she wants diet, and she says no, regular, then asks if he thinks she’s fat. He says no. She says she’s not the model. Matt says the sugar makes her cranky. She insists she’s not cranky. Matt says he’ll be right back and tells her to talk to Elizabeth before he leaves the room.
related_events: Scottie takes Elizabeth's picture

Don’t leave me alone with my idiot Dad.' Scottie asks how her mother will read it, pointing out that Elizabeth is in a coma. Matt grows frustrated, insisting that her refusal to speak is what her mother is hearing now. He says they won’t leave until Scottie talks to her. He offers to give her privacy and even suggests she recite the alphabet if she can’t think of anything. Before stepping out, he asks what she wants to drink. Scottie asks for a regular Sprite, not diet, and asks if Matt thinks she’s fat. He says she’s not. Matt leaves to get the drink, telling her to talk to her mother while he’s gone.

description: Mark and Kai entered the room carrying a mini-boombox, which they turned on, filling the space with music. Matt, who had been sitting in silence, looked up as the atmosphere shifted around him.

name: Kai Applies Makeup to Elizabeth
description: Kai leans close to Elizabeth, carefully applying makeup to her face. She smooths foundation over Elizabeth’s skin, brushes color onto her cheeks, and lines her eyes with steady hands. As she works, she talks about recent gossip, speaking as if Elizabeth were awake and listening. She pauses to dab lipstick onto Elizabeth’s lips, pressing them together gently with her fingertips. The room stays quiet except for Kai’s voice, soft and steady, filling the space with familiar rhythms. Mark and Matt watch in silence as Kai finishes, her movements deliberate, almost reverent.

Kai applies lipstick to Elizabeth's lips with gentle, deliberate movements

name: Mark Asks for Updates, Matt Responds
description: Mark turned to Matt and asked if there had been any changes in Elizabeth’s condition. Matt shook his head, saying the swelling was still being monitored and her kidneys and other vitals remained stable—no progress, but no decline either. As he spoke, Kai glanced up from where she was capping the lipstick, then went back to smoothing a hand over Elizabeth’s hair. Matt paused, then offered a small smile, mentioning the extra meals Kai had left in his fridge. Kai nodded without looking away from Elizabeth, her fingers adjusting a strand of hair at her temple.

The room is quiet except for the soft hum of the mini-boombox playing in the background. Without speaking, Matt and Mark acknowledge each other, their shared look passing between them like a quiet understanding of Kai’s way of coping, of caring, of keeping things alive.

name: Matt and Alexandra Discuss Telling Family About the Mother's Condition
description: Matt and Alexandra sit together on the sofas. Alexandra looks exhausted, her face marked by recent tears. Matt tells her he found out about the situation the day before and that they need to go through it together, along with Scottie. He explains that he needs to tell their family and close friends in person, and sometimes he will need her to come with him, while other times he will need her to stay back and watch Scottie. Alexandra asks if he wants her to go around announcing that their mother is going to die, calling the idea depressing and suggesting he just call people instead. Matt replies that no one wants to do this, but it’s important to let people like Grandpa and Tutu know, so they can say goodbye. Alexandra says she doesn’t want to talk about her mother with anyone. Matt tells her to let go of whatever she fought about with her mother at Christmas, urging her to grow up and remember that they love each other. Alexandra insists she can’t let it go. Matt repeats that she has to. Alexandra then tells him that her mother was cheating on him, that she saw her with another man during Christmas. She describes seeing her mother and a man walking into a house, his hand on her ass. Matt questions whether she’s sure it was her mother. Alexandra confirms it and says she confronted her, but her mother denied it and yelled at her. Matt asks who the man was. Alexandra says she doesn’t know, just some guy with dark hair. Matt stands up, walks in a small circle, then stops. He tells Alexandra to watch Scottie and leaves the room.
related_events: Matt insists on informing family and friends about the mother's condition
Alexandra expresses resistance to sharing the news with others

He says sometimes he’ll need her to come along, other times to stay back and watch Scottie. Alexandra refuses, asking why she should go around telling people their mother is dying, calling it depressing. Matt insists that Grandpa and Tutu and a few others deserve to know, that they should have the chance to say goodbye. Alexandra says she doesn’t want to talk about her mother with anyone. Matt tells her to let go of whatever happened between her and her mother at Christmas, to grow up, to remember that they love each other. Alexandra says she can’t let it go. Matt repeats that she has to. Alexandra looks at him and says her mother was cheating on him. She saw her with a man at Black Point, his hand on her ass, walking into a house. Matt questions her, asking if she’s sure it was her, what the man looked like. Alexandra says he had dark hair. Matt stands up, walks in a tight circle, then stops. She describes how she confronted her mother, who first pretended not to understand, then became angry and denied everything. Alexandra says she was planning to tell Matt about it before the accident, but held back. She expresses her disgust at what she saw and says she couldn’t stand being around her mother afterward. Matt questions her, asking if she’s sure it was her mother, and what the man looked like. Alexandra says he had dark hair. Matt stands, pacing slightly, then stops. Without speaking, he tells Alexandra to watch Scottie and walks away.

Emily tries to run but stumbles and falls, clutching her golf club and a bottle. Matt expresses disbelief, remarking on the cost of tuition and the situation unfolding before him. He calls out to Alexandra, who reacts with surprise and laughter, addressing him as 'Dad.' The supervisor scolds the girls for their language and behavior. Scottie tells Alexandra they are there to take her home, explaining that Matt has already pulled her out of school for several days. When Matt says Alexandra needs to come see her mother, Alexandra strides forward and hurls her golf club into the darkness, shouting a curse. The supervisor again rebukes her for her language.

Alexandra mocks his presence, her words slurred, while Scottie tries to explain they came to take her home. She slips beneath the surface of the pool and swims underwater, her face strained. After a moment, she surfaces, climbs out of the pool, and wraps a towel around herself, crying. She turns to Matt and asks why he chose to tell her in the pool. Matt steps out and moves toward her with his arms open. Matt questions why she didn’t speak up earlier, and Scottie explains she thought the eggs were for him. Alexandra enters, takes a Coca-Cola from the fridge, and sits down without responding to Matt’s greeting. He asks if her mother allows Coke for breakfast, and she replies that it’s after eleven. Matt asks how she’s feeling, and when he guesses she’s hungover, she shrugs. He comments that he didn’t expect otherwise and says they should talk, but not in front of Scottie. Scottie says she doesn’t mind. Matt tells Alexandra he thought she was getting her act together. She insists she has, pointing out her improved grades and her role in a school play that no one from the family attended. She challenges Matt, asking if he even remembers the name of the play. He hesitates, unable to answer. She raises her voice, angry that her efforts go unnoticed, and says it shouldn’t matter if she got drunk one night when he finally showed up. Matt tells her to watch her language around Scottie. She ignores the warning and says she’s going swimming. Matt says he’ll join her. She mutters, 'Good times,' and leaves the kitchen.

name: Troy Approaches the Kings and Asks About Elizabeth
description: Troy Cook, a muscular and well-dressed man, notices Matt and Scottie at their table and makes his way over, pausing briefly to tell his friends he’ll join them shortly. He greets Matt and Scottie by name. Matt responds with a flat 'Troy.' Troy asks how Elizabeth is doing. Matt says only, 'Same.' Troy says he visited her the previous week and thought she looked good, adding that her hand moved while he was talking to her, which he took as an encouraging sign. Scottie looks up at this, but Matt cuts in, telling Troy it’s enough. Troy insists he’s praying for her every day and expresses how much he cares. Matt tells him to go back to his friends, saying there are no hard feelings but making it clear the conversation is over. Troy begins to walk away, then turns back. He reminds Matt that conditions were rough that day on the water, that there were big waves and sharp turns, and that what happened to Elizabeth could just as easily have happened to him. Matt replies, 'You weren't supposed to be driving, Troy. She was supposed to be driving.'
